newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI says most units improve in half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI says most units improve in half.

text.p: Heavy engineering group Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Tuesday all of its units improved performances in the six months ended December 31, 1996, expect for its Comsteel and ANI Mineral Processing units.
ANI earlier reported a net profit of A$16.33 million in the 1996/97 first half, compared with A$5.19 million a year earlier, with sales rising 0.7 percent to A$987.30 million.

The company said the half year net profit included a A$8.7 million abnormal gain, a result of the sale of investments and gains made on the settlement with the government over the closure of the Cockatoo dockyard in Sydney.
